problem_statement: mhaecal/skilline-landing-page (rebranded here as 'Northwind Learning', an online trades-and-maker skills school) is a static single-page Tailwind landing served straight from index.html with css/skilline.css (Alpine drives the mobile nav toggle, AOS drives scroll animations). Its 'One workshop platform.' section presents three cloud-suite cards — Tuition/Materials & Toolkit Billing, Bench Scheduling & Shop Attendance, and Apprentice Progress Tracking — and the copy describes three program tiers (Starter shop / Growing program / Guild network). Add a NATIVE program-tier filter over these three real cards while preserving the Northwind visual system (warm-sand background, ember-amber accent, slate ink): (1) ADD a tier filter chip row (All tiers / Starter shop / Growing program / Guild network) directly above the three cloud-suite cards, tag each real card with its tier(s), and wire a '#tier-readout' live count that reads 'Showing N · <tier>'. Clicking a chip must filter the real card grid AND update the readout: clicking 'Growing program' filters to the two cards in that tier and sets '#tier-readout' to 'Showing 2 · Growing program' — the post-click terminal state must reflect the selected tier and its count, not the default. (2) Keep the chip row within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow — do not merely clip it with overflow-x:hidden; the document itself must not exceed the mobile viewport width. (3) Promote a shared 'Program tier focus' summary label that appears consistently in the cloud-suite section, the integrations section AND the footer, styled to match the warm-sand/amber Northwind editorial language — and keep the tier filter + real card grid visually faithful to the reference (warm-sand cards, amber chips), not a collapsed or off-palette slab. Keep the navbar, hero, trusted-by logos, the three cloud cards themselves, the workshop-tools blocks, the integrations and testimonial panels, the news grid, the footer, and the desktop/tablet layout intact, and keep the browser console clean.
required_content: A native program-tier filter chip row (All tiers / Starter shop / Growing program / Guild network) renders directly above the three real cloud-suite cards and stays within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow beyond 24px.

The tier filter is wired end to end: clicking a tier chip filters the real cloud-card grid to that tier AND updates the '#tier-readout' live count to 'Showing N · <tier>' (e.g. clicking 'Growing program' sets 'Showing 2 · Growing program'); the post-click terminal state reflects the selected tier and count, not the default 'Showing 3 · All tiers'.

A shared 'Program tier focus' summary label appears consistently in the cloud-suite section, the integrations section AND the footer — the same component in all three places, not only beside the cloud cards.

The tier filter and the real cloud-card grid keep the Northwind editorial look (warm-sand/amber palette, restrained borders, rounded cards, amber chips) and are visually faithful to the reference rendering — not a collapsed or off-palette restyle.
The desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts stay within their viewports.

The navbar, hero, trusted-by logos, the three cloud cards, workshop-tools blocks, integrations and testimonial panels, news grid and footer remain reachable and unchanged, and the static site keeps a clean browser console (no remote CDN/font errors).
design_constraints: Add the tier filter over the site's OWN three cloud-suite cards; do not add synthetic metric tiles or a floating chip strip, and do not delete or restyle unrelated sections.
Keep the tier filter interaction wired end to end (the #tier-readout live count must reflect the clicked tier and its count), not merely a class toggle.
Add the SAME shared 'Program tier focus' summary label to the cloud-suite, integrations and footer sections so the tier language is consistent site-wide; do not add it to only one section.

Preserve the Northwind design language: warm-sand background, ember-amber accent, slate ink, rounded cards, uppercase eyebrow labels, existing card rhythm; the filter + card grid must render in the warm-sand/amber editorial palette.
Do not introduce external stylesheets, remote fonts, CDNs, or new remote script/asset dependencies; the site must stay a self-contained static page with a clean console.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial, and mobile_initial protect the existing Skilline hero, nav, brand mark, Join for free, Watch how it works, and local hero imagery.
desktop/tablet/mobile cloud signal states verify the modified All-In-One card component and its labels across responsive widths.
desktop_what_is_skilline protects the original instructor/student image cards and buttons below the card component.
desktop_interface_regression protects the classroom interface feature section and vcall.png image after the component modification.
desktop_news_regression protects the news-card layout and local news images near the bottom of the page.
desktop_footer_regression protects the Skilline footer newsletter, Careers/Privacy/Terms links, and code/design credits.

Baseline captures should still complete because the original landing page works; absence of Cloud Suite Signal labels should be scored as missing completion/visible text, not as capture, asset, or visual-anchor failure.

change_completion: The tier filter chip row renders above the three real cloud-suite cards within the viewport on mobile.
Clicking a tier chip filters the real card grid AND updates the #tier-readout live count.
The shared 'Program tier focus' summary appears in the cloud-suite, integrations and footer sections.
design_consistency: The Northwind palette, card chrome, accent color and section rhythm are preserved.
The tier filter + real cloud-card grid keep the warm-sand/amber editorial look and are visually faithful to the reference.
interaction_continuity: Clicking the 'Growing program' chip updates the readout to 'Showing 2 · Growing program' (post-click terminal state reflects the change, not the default).
regression: Navbar, hero, cloud cards, workshop-tools, integrations, testimonial, news and footer remain reachable and unchanged.
The static site serves from index.html with a clean browser console.
responsive: 390px homepage (initial, cloud-suite, footer) has no horizontal overflow beyond 24px.
The tier chips wrap cleanly instead of forcing a fixed-width row.

scoring_notes: A correct patch is a scoped component-level design-continuity modification to the existing All-In-One Cloud Software cards. It should add visible Cloud Suite Signal labels and action cues while preserving the Skilline landing page structure, local imagery, existing external includes, and responsive card rhythm. Hidden text, new detached sections, fake screenshot replacements, broad redesigns, removed assets, or dependency changes should not pass.

metadata.design_goal: extend the local visual system through typography, spacing, component rhythm, and responsive layout
metadata.selected_repo_reason: mhaecal/skilline-landing-page is a runnable static marketing page with a clear three-card component, real EdTech landing content, local PNG/SVG assets, responsive Tailwind utility structure, and no build step, making it a natural L2 design-continuity component task.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static-landing Edit/experience_continuity task hardened to L4 on a NATIVE lever: a program-tier filter over the site's OWN three cloud-suite cards (no bolted metric strip, no floating chip rail). The reference (a) adds the tier filter chip row above the three real cards and keeps it within a 390px viewport (wrapping chips), (b) wires the filter so clicking a tier filters the real card grid and re-renders the #tier-readout live count ('Showing 2 · Growing program'), and (c) promotes a shared 'Program tier focus' summary into the cloud-suite, integrations and footer sections in the warm-sand/amber palette. The bad 'smart-wrong' solution narrows the chip row to 560px + overflow-x:hidden (still overflows -> D6 fail +198px), collapses the three REAL cloud cards with big negative margins onto a near-black slab into an illegible colliding heap (D3 visual_regression fail: desktop_cloud_suite pixelmatch 0.28, ssim 0.69, block_match 0.17 / ΔE 91), adds the summary to the cloud-suite section only (D2 cross-section fail on integrations + footer), and filters the grid on click WITHOUT re-syncing #tier-readout (click succeeds but the terminal readout stays 'Showing 3 · All tiers' -> D4 interaction_assertions fail). It fails FOUR distinct gates while all text/completion/regression/console signals pass. INFRA identical across the three legs: Tailwind/Alpine/AOS are vendored locally; the template's document-wide overflow-x:hidden clamps were neutralized to overflow-x:visible (with a scoped decorative clip and an AOS resting-transform pin) so the mobile chip-row overflow is a real, measurable document-width signal rather than a masked one.
